'''Gamorrean hooch''' was a type of beverage drunk by members of the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pzob/Legends|Pzob]]. Prior to his work for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], the Gamorrean [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]] accidentally produced a [[Fireball Belch]] and burnt the [[Nose/Legends|snout]] of a clan rival named [[Scumbo/Legends|Scumbo]] after consuming a barrel of Gamorrean hooch and a particularly heavy brunch.<ref name="BT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gamorrean hooch was first mentioned in the second entry of ''[[Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire]]'', a series of articles published on the [[Star Wars Blog]] on [[StarWars.com]] and written by [[Rich Handley]] and [[Abel G. Peña]] in [[2013]]. The hooch was used as part of the explanation behind Thok's ability to produce fireballs in<ref name="BT" /> the [[1997]]<ref name="Release">{{GalaxyCite|13|Game Room|Game Room: Game Knights}}</ref> [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Masters of Teräs Käsi]]''.<ref name="BT" />
